errors.text_span: 训练准确率在第10个epoch后趋于平缓，稳定在约0.85
errors.evidence: The description claims the training accuracy flattens after epoch 10 and stabilizes at 0.85. However, the plot shows the training accuracy continues to rise significantly after epoch 10 (from approx. 0.78 to over 0.9) and stabilizes at a value above 0.9, not 0.85.

errors.text_span: 验证准确率在第10个epoch后也趋于平缓，稳定在约0.82
errors.evidence: The description claims the validation accuracy flattens after epoch 10 and stabilizes at 0.82. However, the plot shows the validation accuracy continues to rise after epoch 10 (from approx. 0.75 to 0.85) and stabilizes at a value of approximately 0.85, not 0.82.

errors.text_span: 表明模型在训练集和验证集上的表现较为接近，未出现明显的过拟合现象
errors.evidence: This statement is an interpretation of the model's performance (e.g., "no obvious overfitting"), which goes beyond a factual description of what is visually present in the chart.
